lavanda.title: Lavanda Florărie
lavanda.description: An online storefront for a boutique flower shop, built around rich floral photography, bouquet filtering, and a frictionless same-day ordering flow.
lavanda.deliverables: Storefront design, product catalog, checkout flow

douaroti.title: Două Roți
douaroti.description: A complete commerce platform and service locator for a specialist bicycle and e-bike retailer, handling a large technical catalog with custom filtering.
douaroti.deliverables: E-commerce architecture, catalog structure, service booking

biciclete.title: Biciclete Copii
biciclete.description: A dedicated store for children's bicycles that helps parents choose the right frame size and safety gear without guesswork.
biciclete.deliverables: Storefront UI, age & height sizing guide, product catalog

services.label: Capabilities
services.title: What I design and build.
services.intro: Every project is handled end to end, from the first layout sketch in Figma to the live domain and store setup.

design.title: Web design
design.scope: Brand sites, landing pages, custom layouts

uiux.title: Interface & UX design
uiux.description: Clear navigation, readable typography, and calm buying flows that make it obvious what your business offers and how a customer can act.

development.title: Frontend development
development.scope: React, Next.js, fast static & dynamic builds
development.description: Clean, maintainable code that loads fast on mobile networks, ranks well in search engines, and stays reliable over time.

wordpress.title: WordPress & e-commerce
wordpress.description: Complete online stores and content sites that your team can update, restock, and run day to day without needing a developer for every change.

about.label: About
about.title: Curious by nature, deliberate about every detail.
about.p1: I started building websites out of plain curiosity and turned that craft into my profession. Alongside client work, I launch and run my own e-commerce projects from Oradea, Romania, which means I approach every design from a business owner's perspective.
about.p2: I care about the details people feel immediately: how quickly a page responds, how comfortable the typography is to read, and how effortless it feels to go from browsing a product to placing an order.
